Class UserDAO

java.lang.Object
org.store.dao.UserDAO
public class UserDAO extends Object
Data Access Object (DAO) for managing User entities. Handles database operations related to user registration, authentication, and profile management.

Security Note: Passwords are never stored in plain text. This class uses the BCrypt algorithm to hash passwords during registration and verify them during login.

  • Method Details

    • registerUser

      public boolean registerUser(User user)
      Registers a new user in the database.

      Implementation details: 1. Generates a salt and hashes the user's password using BCrypt. 2. Inserts the user into the 'elstore_users' table with the default role 'CLIENT'.

      Parameters:
      user - The User object containing username, email, and raw password.
      Returns:
      true if the user was successfully registered; false otherwise (e.g., if email already exists).

    • loginUser

      public User loginUser(String email, String rawPassword)
      Authenticates a user by email and password.

      It fetches the user by email and uses BCrypt.checkpw(String, String) to verify if the provided raw password matches the stored hash.

      Parameters:
      email - The user's email address.
      rawPassword - The plain text password entered by the user.
      Returns:
      A User object (excluding the password) if authentication is successful; null otherwise.

    • findByEmail

      public User findByEmail(String email)
      Retrieves full user details by email. Used for loading profile information (address, phone, etc.).
      Parameters:
      email - The email address to search for.
      Returns:
      A User object with populated fields, or null if not found.

    • updateUser

      public boolean updateUser(User user)
      Updates user profile information. Allows changing the username, address, and phone number. Note: Email is used as the key and cannot be changed via this method.
      Parameters:
      user - The User object containing updated info.
      Returns:
      true if the update was successful.

    • changePassword

      public boolean changePassword(String email, String oldPassword, String newPassword)
      Securely changes the user's password.

      Workflow: 1. Fetches the current password hash from the database. 2. Verifies that the provided oldPassword matches the current hash. 3. If correct, hashes the newPassword and updates the database record.

      Parameters:
      email - The user's email.
      oldPassword - The current password (plain text) for verification.
      newPassword - The new password (plain text) to be set.
      Returns:
      true if the password was successfully changed; false if the old password was incorrect or an error occurred.
